title: Our ultimate choice …
excerpt: Countdown Day 25: We are increasingly faced with a choice, I believe, not between kindness and hostility, but between kindness and nonexistence. (Brian D. McLaren, Why Did Jesus, Moses, the Buddha, and Mohammed Cross the Road? p. 12) Learn more here: http://bit.ly/R8fzUI
body:
Countdown Day 25:

We are increasingly faced with a choice, I believe, not between kindness and hostility, but between kindness and nonexistence. (Brian D. McLaren, Why Did Jesus, Moses, the Buddha, and Mohammed Cross the Road? p. 12)

Learn more here: http://bit.ly/R8fzUI
